findings.eligibility: public charging on Electra-owned Italy network; subscription discounts are separate and must not replace the public direct tariff
positiveEvidence: Electra help article published 2026-07-01 states the listed prices apply to sessions started via Electra app, Autocharge or bank-card terminal.
Italy row lists 0.69 EUR/kWh app and 0.79 EUR/kWh card, VAT included, for slow and fast charging (AC-DC).

Electra variable-pricing article published 2026-07-07 explicitly identifies France, Belgium and Spain as countries using station/time-variable pricing; Italy is not included in that variable-pricing set.

Electra+ subscription discounts are eligibility-specific and are not substituted for the public tariff.
ChargeLeague partner-network prices are kept separate from native Electra-network direct pricing.
